options.content:
Bot Insights -- SEO Governance
Governance overview: crawler health, AI traffic attribution, and policy-page evidence.
Data Freshness: ${data_freshness}

panels.description: 2xx success rate for governance pages (robots.txt, llms.txt). Should be above 98%. Below 90% is critical -- crawlers cannot discover your site policies.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ${timestamp} AS time,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode >= 200 AND statusCode < 300) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS value
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND resourceCategory IN ('robots.txt', 'sitemap.xml', 'ads.txt', 'llms.txt')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time ASC
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Crawler File Success Rate; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Crawler File Success Rate

panels.description: 2xx success rate for known good bot families (Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, etc.). Target: above 98%. Any sustained 429 rate against good bots means rate-limiting rules are incorrectly scoped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ${timestamp} AS time,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode >= 200 AND statusCode < 300) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS value
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND userAgentCategory IN ('Search Engine Crawler', 'Social Media Crawler', 'Monitoring Uptime Services', 'SEO Site Monitoring Tool')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Good-bot health; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Good-Bot Health

panels.description: Minutes since most recent ingested event. LIVE = data flowing normally.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  max(${timestamp}) AS time,
  greatest(dateDiff('minute', max(${timestamp}), $__toTime), 0) AS lag_minutes
FROM ${summary_minute}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Data Lag; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Data Lag

panels.description: AI crawler volume by vendor over time. Each aiCategory gets a distinct color. Trend shows whether AI pressure is growing, stable, or shifting between vendors.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ${timestamp} AS time,
  aiCategory,
  cnt_all AS Requests
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND trafficCohort = 'AI'
GROUP BY time, aiCategory
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=AI-labeled traffic trend; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: AI-Labeled Traffic Trend

panels.description: Share of AI crawler traffic by vendor for the current window. Donut shows relative proportion of each AI category.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  aiSource,
  cnt_all AS volume
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND notEmpty(aiSource)
GROUP BY aiSource
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=AI source composition; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: AI Source Composition

panels.description: ASNs ranked by AI crawler traffic volume, broken out by country.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  asn,
  country,
  cnt_all AS volume
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND trafficCohort = 'AI'
GROUP BY asn, country
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top AI sources; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top AI Sources (ASN + Country) (Top 10)

panels.description: Request paths most targeted by AI crawlers. Shows which content is being scraped with AI share percentage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  requestPathPattern AS endpoint,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, trafficCohort = 'AI') AS vol,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, trafficCohort = 'AI') * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 1) AS ai_share_pct
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND notEmpty(requestPathPattern)
GROUP BY requestPathPattern
ORDER BY vol DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=AI targeting top endpoints; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: AI Targeting - Top Paths (Top 10)

panels.description: Status code breakdown for each governance endpoint type (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, ads.txt, llms.txt). One row per resourceCategory. Any non-2xx response is actionable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  resourceCategory,
  cnt_all AS total,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode >= 200 AND statusCode < 300) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS pct_2xx,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode >= 400 AND statusCode < 500) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS pct_4xx,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode = 429) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS pct_429,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode >= 500 AND statusCode < 600) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS pct_5xx
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND resourceCategory IN ('robots.txt', 'sitemap.xml', 'ads.txt', 'llms.txt')
GROUP BY resourceCategory
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 100
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Crawler File Health; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Crawler File Health

panels.description: 429 rate by known good-bot category. Any sustained 429 rate against search, social, monitoring, or SEO crawlers means rate-limiting rules may be incorrectly scoped. Target: 0%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  userAgentCategory,
  cnt_all AS total,
  countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode = 429) AS status_429,
  round(countMergeIf(`count()`, statusCode = 429) * 100.0 / greatest(cnt_all, 1), 2) AS rate_429
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(${timestamp})
  AND $__adHocFilter()
  AND userAgentCategory IN (${userAgentCategories})
GROUP BY userAgentCategory
ORDER BY rate_429 DESC, total DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Good-bot 429 watch; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Good-Bot 429 Watch (Top 50)

panels.description: SIEM policy action and scoring totals by bot type from the policy summary grain selected for the active dashboard range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  botType,
  actionClass,
  cnt_all,
  cnt_blocked,
  countIf(statusCode >= 400 AND statusCode < 500) as cnt_4xx,
  countIf(statusCode >= 500 AND statusCode < 600) as cnt_5xx,
  avg_botScore
FROM ${siem_policy_table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__adHocFilter()
GROUP BY
  botType,
  actionClass
ORDER BY cnt_all DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=AI Crawler SIEM Enrichment; du=${__user.login}'
